description: This file defines the Control.Layers class for the Leaflet mapping library, providing UI controls for switching base layers and overlays on a map. It includes class methods, options, and event handling logic.

classes.name: Layers
classes.description: A control class extending Control, providing UI for toggling base layers and overlays on a map.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the control with base layers, overlays, and options.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Handles adding the control to the map, setting up layout and event listeners.

methods.name: addTo
methods.description: Adds the control to a specified map.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Handles removal of the control from the map, removing event listeners.

methods.name: addBaseLayer
methods.description: Adds a base layer to the control.

methods.name: addOverlay
methods.description: Adds an overlay layer to the control.

methods.name: removeLayer
methods.description: Removes a specified layer from the control.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands the control UI if collapsed.

methods.name: collapse
methods.description: Collapses the control UI if expanded.

methods.name: _initLayout
methods.description: Initializes the HTML layout of the control.

methods.name: _getLayer
methods.description: Retrieves a layer object by its ID.

methods.name: _addLayer
methods.description: Adds a layer to internal list and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: _update
methods.description: Updates the UI to reflect current layers and states.

methods.name: _onLayerChange
methods.description: Handles layer add/remove events to update UI and fire map events.

methods.name: _createRadioElement
methods.description: Creates a radio button input element.

methods.name: _addItem
methods.description: Adds a layer item (checkbox or radio) to the control UI.

methods.name: _onInputClick
methods.description: Handles click events on layer inputs to toggle layers.

methods.name: _checkDisabledLayers
methods.description: Disables inputs based on layer zoom constraints.

methods.name: _expandIfNotCollapsed
methods.description: Expands control if not collapsed.

methods.name: _expand
methods.description: Expands the control UI.

methods.name: _collapse
methods.description: Collapses the control UI.
